purpose: Display and operate on tabular data. Virtualized; holds its own sort, filter, search, selection, column and pagination state in an external store exposed through GridApi.
$operationsNote: Mirrors agent/operations.ts, which is what the runtime actually dispatches on. tools/eval/__tests__/corpus.test.ts fails if the two drift. `apiMethod` is present only where one GridApi method performs the operation.

search.summary: Free-text match across every searchable column.

filter.summary: Apply a typed filter to one column. Operators are constrained by the column's type.

column.description: Column id from the runtime contract.

value2.description: Upper bound; only for the `between` operator.

clearFilters.summary: Remove every column filter and the search text.

sort.summary: Sort by one column, replacing the current sort unless `append` is set.

append.description: Add to the existing sort instead of replacing it.

clearSort.summary: Return to the data's original order.

selectRows.summary: Select or deselect rows by id.

selectAll.summary: Select, or clear, every row matching the current filters.

pinColumn.summary: Pin a column to an edge, or unpin it with a null side.

moveColumn.summary: Move a column before or after another one.

setColumnWidth.summary: Set a column's width in pixels, or null to restore its default.

resetColumns.summary: Restore column order, width, visibility and pinning to their defaults.

setPage.summary: Jump to a page, counting from zero.

setPageSize.summary: Change how many rows a page holds.

export.summary: Download the chosen rows as a file.
export.note: Three formats, three GridApi methods (exportCsv, exportExcel, exportPdf), so no single apiMethod applies.

print.summary: Open the browser's print dialog with the table laid out for paper.

copy.summary: Copy the selected rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

undo.summary: Restore the state from before the last operation.
undo.note: Performed by the agent runtime's snapshot history, not by GridApi.

redo.summary: Re-apply the operation that was last undone.
redo.note: Performed by the agent runtime's snapshot history, not by GridApi.

supplied: WAI-ARIA grid pattern: role=row/rowgroup, aria-colindex, aria-rowindex
aria-multiselectable when row selection is enabled
full cell keyboard navigation, including the header row
required: aria-label on the grid when its purpose is not obvious from the page
a visible heading or caption nearby for screen-reader context

composition.notes: Self-contained. Columns are configuration, not children. Keep `data`, `columns` and `getRowId` referentially stable — the grid memoizes on their identity.

safeMutations.rationale: Presentation is safe to change. `data`/`columns`/`getRowId` are memoization keys — replacing them re-creates the grid model. `mode` and the state callbacks define the client/server contract.

propNotes.mode: `client` lets the grid sort, filter and paginate. `server` means `data` is already the current page and the host answers `onQueryChange`.
propNotes.state: Makes the grid controlled. Prefer `initialState` unless the host genuinely owns the state.

notImplemented: grouping — no API, no state field, no operation
aggregation — no API, no state field, no operation
row-level mutation — no add, delete or set-cell API; editing is a UI affordance only
notIn — a column with fixed options filters by membership only; an exclusion must list the complement
multi-value filter on a plain string column — one column holds one filter
